title: FAIR Plan policy growth slows to 1.9% in Q2 2026
discussion_signal: The post interprets slower FAIR Plan growth alongside policies moving back to the regular market, while emphasizing that households may not receive a clear notice that an exit route has opened. It adds an operational and informational-access dimension to residual-market growth.
linked_research_question: How does insurance-market retreat or return change household security, information, and the ability to remain in or exit a place?
limits: The post is a broker/industry interpretation rather than a representative household survey
The quoted counts require verification against the underlying FAIR Plan release
Movement between markets does not identify affordability or coverage quality
